fields.title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
fields.description: We are building the next generation of autonomous AI systems. You will architect and ship production-grade agentic workflows using LangGraph and FastMCP, integrating with Claude and other frontier LLMs. You will own the full pipeline: from tool design and agent orchestration to evaluation and deployment.
responsibilities: Design and implement multi-node LangGraph workflows for autonomous decision-making
Build and maintain FastMCP tool servers for real-world API orchestration
Integrate Anthropic Claude API for high-nuance reasoning tasks
Own end-to-end agent evaluation: correctness, latency, cost
Collaborate with product and backend teams to ship agentic features
Write technical documentation and mentor junior engineers
Contribute to internal and open-source tooling

fields.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
fields.description: You will own the infrastructure layer that keeps our AI systems running reliably at scale. This includes containerised deployments, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and cloud cost optimisation. You will work closely with AI engineers to ensure models and agents ship fast and break rarely.
responsibilities: Design and manage Kubernetes clusters for AI workloads
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and ArgoCD
Implement observability stacks: Prometheus, Grafana, alerting
Optimise cloud costs on AWS and GCP
Manage secrets, env config, and infra-as-code with Terraform
Support model serving infrastructure (vLLM, TorchServe)
On-call rotation for production incidents

fields.title: LLM Product Engineer
fields.description: You will translate LLM capabilities into product features users love. This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering and product development — you'll prototype fast, gather user feedback, and ship polished AI-powered features across our platform.
responsibilities: Build and iterate on RAG pipelines for product features
Integrate LangGraph agents into user-facing workflows
Collaborate with designers and PMs to define AI feature specs
Evaluate LLM outputs for quality, safety, and user experience
Build internal tools for prompt management and A/B testing
Ship Next.js + FastAPI features end-to-end
Write clear documentation for AI feature behaviour

fields.title: ML Engineer – Fine-tuning & Evaluation
fields.description: You will own the model quality layer of our AI stack. You'll design fine-tuning experiments, build evaluation harnesses, and ensure our deployed models perform reliably across production use cases. This is a research-meets-engineering role — rigour and speed both matter.
responsibilities: Design and run LoRA/PEFT fine-tuning experiments on open-source LLMs
Build automated evaluation pipelines for LLM output quality
Curate and clean training datasets for domain-specific tasks
Track experiments using W&B or MLflow
Implement RLHF feedback collection pipelines
Benchmark models on latency, cost, and accuracy
Write research notes and share findings with the team

fields.title: AI Backend Engineer (Junior)
fields.description: You will build the backend services that power our AI platform. This is an excellent entry point for engineers who want to grow into AI engineering — you'll work on real production systems from day one, with mentorship from senior engineers.
responsibilities: Build and maintain Django REST Framework APIs
Write Celery tasks for async AI workloads
Optimise PostgreSQL queries and schema design
Integrate vector database endpoints into backend services
Write unit and integration tests (pytest)
Participate in code reviews and team planning
Learn and adopt FastAPI and async Python patterns over time

fields.title: Full-Stack AI Product Developer
fields.description: You will own the UI layer of our AI products — from agent trace dashboards to real-time evaluation interfaces. You're comfortable in both React/Next.js and Python/FastAPI and you have a strong sense of what good AI product UX looks like.
responsibilities: Build Next.js dashboards for agent monitoring and evaluation
Implement real-time updates with Supabase Realtime / WebSockets
Design and ship reusable UI components with shadcn/ui and Tailwind
Integrate FastAPI backend endpoints into the frontend
Collaborate with AI engineers to visualise agent reasoning traces
Conduct user interviews and iterate on UI based on recruiter feedback
Own frontend performance and accessibility

fields.title: Vector Search & Data Engineer
fields.description: You will build the retrieval backbone of our AI systems. From embedding pipelines to hybrid graph+vector search, you'll ensure our agents can find the right information fast. This role requires deep curiosity about data architecture and retrieval quality.
responsibilities: Design and maintain vector embedding pipelines for resume and document data
Implement hybrid search combining pgvector and graph traversal
Evaluate and benchmark retrieval quality across different embedding models
Build data ingestion pipelines from PDF, HTML, and API sources
Optimise query latency for real-time search use cases
Maintain data quality standards and monitoring
Document data schemas and search architecture
